verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a chargeback capability to "manage, respond to, and track chargeback cases," which covers the dispute-handling core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows this is exposed through an API that an agent could drive end-to-end. The Agent Skills and llms.txt items are integration guidance for coding assistants, not dispute endpoints, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints to retrieve disputes, an evidence upload/assembly mechanism, a programmatic submission endpoint, dispute webhooks or status tracking, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API

citations.quote: Manage, respond to, and track chargeback cases efficiently to protect revenue and reduce financial losses.
